acceptance_predicates.description: Owned directory preparation validates every ancestor through a descriptor-relative or equivalent fail-closed operation and cannot follow a replacement symlink.
Atomic single-file and campaign publication rejects destination or ancestor replacement without writing outside the authorized directory.
Positive, repeat, nested, dry-run, concurrent, permission, read-only, rollback, non-directory, symlink, replacement, and cleanup cases pass.
Setup/config, project/tool, plan, run/sweep, report, record/campaign, easy, and TUI routes keep human notices on stderr and JSON stdout unchanged.
No credentials, private paths, payloads, or runtime downloads are introduced and offline-after-install, schemas, exits, and modes remain unchanged.

definition_of_done: Descriptor-safe implementation and deterministic replacement-race tests are independently reviewed.
All AR-1770 focused and full applicable gates, including hosted formal/platform/model checks, are green.
Exact-head PR, merge, post-merge receipt, and durable acceptance are recorded.

inputs.description: AR-1767 directory preparation, notices, and known residual review findings.
ASB atomic writers and recording campaign publication paths.

outputs.description: Replacement-safe owned directory and atomic publication implementation.
Focused route, filesystem, stream, dry-run, and concurrency tests with durable evidence.

gates.description: Replacement and concurrent reuse tests prove no outside target is followed or modified.
All positive/negative route and filesystem cases pass with exact stream and privacy assertions.
Independent exact-head review and all required hosted gates are green.
